_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Aging Airplane Inspections and Records Reviews Report
summary: Defines the format and content of a report used to maintain a cumulative record of aircraft repairs, alterations, and inspection status to support FAA aging airplane reporting requirements under 14 CFR 121.1105.
use_relationship:
Paragraph 1105 of Part 121 of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) defines reporting requirements to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for records reviews of aging airplanes. The purpose of this report is to maintain a cumulative record of repairs and alterations on aircraft to support FAA reporting requirements.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content for the data product resulting from the work task specified in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: NOTE: Any applicable updates or changes to 14 CFR, Section 121.1105(d) shall apply to this report and be incorporated at the next revision/update. Any updates or changes to 14 CFR, Section 121.1105(d) that result in cost changes will be addressed under a contract modification.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following information related to the program:

children.title: Report title
Report number, revision, and date
Revision record
Contract number
Corporate name and address
Signature block(s) showing corporate release approval
Security classification
Distribution statement
Destruction notice
Data content
children.content: as defined in the Code of Federal Regulations, Title 14 (14 CFR) Section 121.1105(d), items (i) through (x), shall be provided for each aircraft in the fleet from the date of delivery for each aircraft. These data points are:

children.title: Total years in service of the airplane
Total time in service of the airframe
Total flight cycles of the airframe
Date of the last inspection and records review required by this section
Current status of life-limited parts of the airframe
Time since the last overhaul of all structural components required to be overhauled on a specific time basis
Current inspection status of the airplane
children.content: including the time since the last inspection required by the inspection program under which the airplane is maintained

children.title: Current status of applicable airworthiness directives
children.content: including the date and methods of compliance, and if the airworthiness directive involves recurring action, the time and date when the next action is required.

children.title: A list of major structural alterations
A report of major structural repairs and the current inspection status for those repairs
